versions.changelog:
Initial release of opc-spv skill — a project governance toolkit tailored for OPC entrepreneurs and project-based teams.

- Provides a full SPV governance “twelve-piece kit” covering all project stages.
- Features dynamic contribution-weighted profit-sharing and team management schemes.
- Includes validated templates for agreements, contribution tracking, profit distribution, and exit strategies.
- Optimized for rapid SPV setup, ensuring clear rules and efficient project collaboration.
